items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, he was up north. They got a picture of him with the band.

ctx.x: That's Buddy. Buddy went with him after me. And I guess Edmund Hall came in on clarinet after a while too. Edmund Hall? You don't know him?
Yeah, Edmund Hall. That's right. That's right. Howl Hall would live on Washington Street's brother.
Yeah, that's right. Yeah, that's right. Yeah, he was up north. They got a picture of him with the band. Mm-hmm.
